## All Plans Include

**Email Triage**

Share, assign and comment on emails across your team.

**Team Collaboration**

Collaborate in the context of work, email, tasks and clients.

**Powerful Workflow**

Assign tasks, create work from templates, schedule jobs, and view dashboards.

**Client Management**

Shared contact profiles, activity timelines, and automated client requests.

**Client Portal**

Collaborate with clients in one streamlined workflow with tasks and document sharing.

**Document Management**

Automatically store and organize documents against clients and jobs.

**Billing & Payments**

Flexible billing and faster payments, built into your workflow.

**Ecosystem Integrations**

Integrate with a suite of apps to streamline data and automate processes.

**Enterprise-grade Security**

24/7 support, 99.9% uptime, enterprise-grade security and regular updates.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How does Karbon pricing work?

Karbon offers three plans (Team, Business, Enterprise), which all include access to the essential Karbon practice management features. Additional features and functionality are included in the higher-priced plans to allow you to select the right option based on your accounting firm’s needs and budget.

Pricing is charged per user. Every team member will need to be invited as a user to your Karbon account if they require access, and your overall subscription will be based on the number of users you have invited.

You can choose to pay monthly or annually, which will give you a reduced rate.

Can I pay in my local currency?

Depending on your location, you can pay for Karbon in US dollars, Canadian dollars, Australian dollars, British pounds, euros, Brazilian real, Mexican pesos, or South African rand.

What implementation support can Karbon help me with?

To ensure a smooth transition to Karbon for your accounting firm, Karbon provides a range of implementation services. These range from group onboarding to guided implementation packages led by a dedicated expert. [You can learn more here](https://karbonhq.com/services/).

What plan is best for my firm?

Three pricing plans are made available to provide choice and flexibility to suit all accounting firms. To view all features and decide what is right for your firm, [view the full feature list](https://karbonhq.com/pricing/#pricing).

The most popular plan used by most customers is the Business plan. If you still can’t decide, [reach out](mailto:sales@karbonhq.com) and a Karbon staff member will be able to assist.

How does Karbon benefit my firm?

Built with collaboration at its core, Karbon is a practice management platform for accounting firms ready to embrace a more connected future. Seamless communication and workflows let teams know who's doing what, when, why, and how. Karbon is cloud-native, frequently updated, highly configurable and a delight to use. Firms running on Karbon are better equipped to drive the success of their business and the prosperity of their clients.

Karbon is the #1 ranked practice management platform for accounting and bookkeeping firms. It is the [accounting practice management category leader on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/karbon-2022-06-30/) and the average employee saves 19.9 hours each week with Karbon.

How often will I be billed, and can I change my billing cycle?

When you sign onto Karbon, you can choose to be billed monthly, annually, or on a multi-year plan. Depending on your agreement, you may be able to change this. Your Karbon Account Executive will explain your options to you before you sign.
